title: Concentration and Nucleic Acid Extraction of Viruses from Wastewater Primary Sludge
author: Ari N Machtinger
materials: Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

Gather the materials and reagents for the Zymo quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit in the Biosafety Cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

steps.title: Prepare 1% Tween 20 stock
steps.instruction: Combine 5 mL Tween 20 with 495 mL 1X PBS, filter‑sterilize using a 0.22 µm vacuum filtration unit; this yields enough 1 % (v/v) Tween 20/PBS for ~24 dissociation treatments.

steps.title: Transfer and unseal sludge sample
steps.instruction: Following the Safety Warnings, move the refrigerated sludge sample from its secondary container to the fume hood, remove the bottle, and peel off the Parafilm to unseal it.

steps.title: Aliquot sludge and prepare control
steps.instruction: Invert the sludge bottle several times, then using a fresh 50 mL serological pipette dispense 20 mL sludge into each 50 mL centrifuge tube (replicates as needed). For a negative control, add 20 mL 1X PBS to a tube. Keep total volume ≤40 mL per tube to avoid leaks.

steps.title: Add Tween 20 to achieve 0.5% final
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of the 1 % (v/v) Tween 20 stock to each tube (including controls) to obtain a final concentration of 0.5 % (v/v) Tween 20.

steps.title: Cap, parafilm, and store sludge bottle
steps.instruction: Cap and Parafilm‑seal all tubes and bottles, wipe exposed surfaces with pre‑empt wipes, return the sludge bottle to secondary containment and place remaining sludge back in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Vortex tubes
steps.instruction: Place all tubes on a vortexer with a 50 mL tube adapter, shake at 1000 rpm for 1 minute.

steps.title: Sonicate tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer tubes to a sonication bath, sonicate at 40 kHz for 1 minute, then dry the tubes with a paper towel.

steps.title: Centrifuge and settle aerosols
steps.instruction: Move tubes to a centrifuge (e.g., Beckman Coulter Avanti J series with JA‑14.50 rotor) and spin at 10 000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 minutes. After spin, wait 10 minutes for aerosols to settle before opening, then return tubes to the fume hood.

steps.title: Set up vacuum filtration apparatus
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, assemble a separate 0.45 µm vacuum filtration unit for each sample/control by attaching the filtration unit to a clean Pyrex bottle.

steps.title: Decant supernatant into filter
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the 40 mL supernatant from each sludge centrifuge tube into its attached 0.45 µm filtration top, avoiding disturbance of the pellet.

steps.title: Perform vacuum filtration
steps.instruction: Cap the filtration top, open the vacuum line, and filter the entire volume. When filtration is complete, cap the Pyrex bottle and set aside. Repeat for each replicate. For the negative control, decant directly into the filtration top (no pellet) and filter similarly.

steps.title: Start‑up InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette
steps.instruction: Turn on the InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette Select, navigate to Maintenance → Start‑up, follow prompts, verify the maintenance tip is installed, place the waste line correctly, remove the storage‑fluid line, insert the foam elution canister, and confirm the screen reads “WWULTRA”.

steps.title: Run concentration on sludge filtrate
steps.instruction: Execute the concentration protocol on the filtered sludge sample (filtrate) using the InnovaPrep.

steps.title: Replace tip and position for elution
steps.instruction: Remove the maintenance tip, install a fresh Ultra CPT tip into the tip port, lower the tip to the bottom of the sample bottle (balance bottle on its edge if needed and use a PBS bottle as a weighted object).

steps.title: Aspirate waste and collect foam eluate
steps.instruction: Press “Start Run”, allow the pipette to aspirate waste, and wait for the beep indicating completion (≈5 minutes). Then, while holding a 5 mL centrifuge tube under the tip, press “Elute” and capture the dispensed foam.

steps.title: Add Zymo DNA/RNA Shield
steps.instruction: After the foam degasses, add 400 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield reagent (1:1 sample:reagent) to obtain ~400 µL eluate.

steps.title: Run concentration on negative control
steps.instruction: Perform the same concentration protocol on the negative‑control filtrate, using a fresh Ultra CPT tip for this sample.

steps.title: Incubate shielded samples
steps.instruction: Incubate all samples containing Zymo DNA/RNA Shield at room temperature for 30 minutes; if they must sit longer, store them at 4 °C.

steps.title: Shut‑down InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette
steps.instruction: Navigate to Maintenance → Shut‑down, place the maintenance tip back, remove the elution canister, verify adequate storage fluid and re‑insert the storage‑fluid line, turn off the device, and remove the waste line.

steps.title: Add Viral DNA/RNA buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1600 µL Viral DNA/RNA buffer to each sample (2:1 buffer:sample ratio) and vortex briefly to mix, following the manufacturer’s recommended volume scaling.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of lysate into a Zymo‑Spin™ IIC‑XLR column in a collection tube, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 2 minutes, discard flow‑through, and repeat until the entire lysate volume has been processed.

steps.title: First viral wash step
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second viral wash step
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous wash: add another 500 µL Viral Wash Buffer, centrifuge 12 000 × g for 30 seconds, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 95‑100 % ethanol to the column, centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Spin to remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a clean collection tube and centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 1 minute (temperature not specified) to eliminate remaining ethanol; this extra step reduces downstream inhibition.

steps.title: Transfer column to nuclease‑free tube
steps.instruction: Carefully move the column into a 1.5 mL nuclease‑free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid with water
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly to the column matrix, incubate at room temperature for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 12 000 × g for 30 seconds to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Aliquot and store nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Make the desired number of aliquots of the extracted nucleic acid, store them at –80 °C. Optionally quantify RNA with the Qubit HS RNA assay kit or DNA with the Qubit 1X dsDNA assay kit before freezing.
